limitations: Roads are original schematic travel corridors joining city coordinates, not surveyed highway alignments.
Small islands are simplified; largest polygon retained and minor secondary islands omitted at small map scale.
Shared collinear border segments are noded before canonical chain simplification; input is expected to be valid administrative coverage.
Natural Earth de facto disputed boundaries remain source representations, not a sovereignty endorsement.
Lagos State's local governments are land only: the Lagos Lagoon and the Lekki Lagoon are gaps, not polygons. The lagoon is derived and is accurate to the raster size (about 22 m).

lagos-lagoon.method: Lagos State (ADM1, includes the lagoon) minus the union of the 20 Lagos local governments (ADM2, land only), traced from a 0.0002 degree raster, pieces under 0.5 km2 and land islands under 0.05 km2 dropped, then simplified once with Visvalingam-Whyatt
lagos-lagoon.generator: scripts/geo/build-boundaries.ts (npm run geo:boundaries; Lagos only unless --nigeria is given)

ibadan-play-area.method: The union of 11 named ADM2 local governments: Akinyele, Egbeda, Ibadan North, Ibadan North East, Ibadan North West, Ibadan South East, Ibadan South West, Ido, Lagelu, Oluyole and Ona Ara. The generated Oyo topology retains all 33 ADM2 local governments. Oyo State is selected only after all 37 ADM1 states are built as one shared-arc topology.

lagos-ibadan-rail-route.method: OSM relation 10699301 is simplified with Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.0005 degrees while retaining source vertices and segment endpoints. The two source components have a recorded 23.4 m gap between nodes 11936864570 and 6287057206; the atlas joins only those recorded endpoints and invents no other bend.

processing.nigeria-and-lagos-boundaries: scripts/geo/build-boundaries.ts caches the two files in .cache/geo, verifies the sha256 and byte count, builds shared-arc topology so a border two regions share is one arc, simplifies each arc once (Visvalingam-Whyatt, effective area in square map units of the Nigeria frame, 1 unit = 100 m) and quantises it (lagos.ts 0.0002 degrees, nigeria.ts 0.001 degrees). Tolerances are recorded in each data file's header.
processing.oyo-boundaries: All 33 Oyo ADM2 features are built in one shared-arc topology at 0.0002 degrees. The full Oyo State outline is cut from a topology built from all 37 ADM1 features, preserving shared boundary arcs for neighbouring state packs. No inland water is inferred from gaps.
